originality.rationale: Nearest priors compared substantively. Van Dam-Haemers LAA 2003 is a DS/NDS survey with no order-stratified n=18 bipartite cubic census, exact polynomials, or diameter table. Godsil-McKay 1982 gives a switching existence construction, not an exhaustive stratum partition with minimal-pair certificate and dual-pipeline recomputation. Robinson-Wormald/McKay nauty-geng/Meringer/House-of-Graphs provide the enumeration universe and counts (149 bicubic at 2n=18) but no adjacency spectra, cospectral classes, or diameter annotation for this stratum. OEIS A006823 and MathWorld bicubic page publish only counts (verified live), not spectra. No prior complete exact-integer-polynomial cospectral partition plus per-class diameter table for connected cubic bipartite n=18 was found in cutoff triage or live spot checks. The 149 count is credited as external, not claimed new; novelty is the spectral partition, explicit pair certificate, and diameter table. Note: topic.json cites arXiv math/0305217 for van Dam-Haemers, which resolves to an unrelated Helein harmonic-maps paper; DRAFT correctly cites the LAA venue, so this is a metadata URL error, not a priority defect.

value.rationale: Independently worth finding later as a citable reference stratum, not a textbook restatement or bare parameter bump. Delivers: (i) machine-checkable 149-type catalog with exact integer charpolys and dual-pipeline agreement (Berkowitz plus Bareiss-interp plus eigvalsh); (ii) full cospectral partition 131 classes with explicit pair/triple witnesses and shared-polynomial certificates; (iii) per-class diameter/girth/n4 table proving diameter is not a spectral invariant in this stratum (triple 55/103/128 diams 5,5,4; pair 22/67 diam 6 vs 5) plus DS-in-stratum census (114 singletons including all three girth-6 types); (iv) seconds-scale stdlib+numpy+sympy re-verifier. Directly reusable for graph-isomorphism benchmarks, spectral-uniqueness (Haemers-conjecture context), and expander references. Consistent with passed census-type findings (binary 5x5 rank census, Sidon Z_60 census).
